scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n catalog,agent,orders,fraud,pneumonia,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta,red,blue,green "npm run dev -w @applied-ai-studio/catalog-api" "npm run dev -w @applied-ai-studio/agent-api" "npm run dev:orders" "npm run dev:fraud" "npm run dev:pneumonia" "npm run dev -w @applied-ai-studio/web"
scripts.dev:orders: node scripts/venv-python.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/order-api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4330 --reload --reload-dir services/order-api/app --reload-dir services/order-api/migrations --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2
scripts.dev:fraud: node scripts/venv-python.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/fraud-api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4340 --reload --reload-dir services/fraud-api/app --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2
scripts.dev:pneumonia: node scripts/venv-python.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/pneumonia-api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4350 --reload --reload-dir services/pneumonia-api/app --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2

scripts.test: npm run test:lifecycle && npm run test -w @applied-ai-studio/catalog-api && npm run test:orders && npm run test:fraud && npm run test:pneumonia
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
